claim: The state a mechanism reaches can be shown without running the game by posing the map: every object a sender's chain answers set to its other state (bloodmap.posed), then rendered from the same poses. It is an endpoint, not a recording: no timing, sound, damage or animation is evidenced by it.
evidence: E4L1: the storm clock (sprite 334) posed shows the quarry at its lightning peak; the briefing recorder (wall 2318) posed shows its collapsed sectors at their on heights
tools/look.py --posed; tools/mechanism_look.py for rest and fired pairs
use: python -m tools.look <project> --set <set> --posed 'sprite N' -o <dir>, and say of the frame that it is posed.
